**Short answer:** For the slimmest option, get the **[Anker Nano Power Bank 5K](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)**. If you want 10,000mAh without much bulk, get the **INIU SnapGo Air**.

**Top picks**

- **Anker Nano 5K (best slim all-rounder), $54.99.** It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and certified Qi2 15W wireless charging. 9to5Mac's reviewer called it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and said it runs cooler than the competition ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)). Buy: [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank).
- **INIU SnapGo Air 10K (best slim high-capacity), about $43-49.** It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless, which your iPhone 17 supports, and 45W wired charging. It includes a lanyard-style 60W cable ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)). Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (thinnest and lightest).** It's 0.27" thick and 104g, but wireless charging is only 7.5W and it costs $52.99-$69.99. It's best if pocket size matters more than speed ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe 5K.** It's 0.35" thick and 119g, with 15W wireless and a semi-solid-state battery, for about $49.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

**How to choose**

- A 5K pack gives roughly a 60-75% charge. A 10K pack charges a phone close to twice ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- The 25W Qi2.2 speed works only on iPhone 16 and later, so your iPhone 17 qualifies.
- Anker's page notes that non-magnetic, thick, or heavily armored cases (over about 2.5mm) can weaken the connection.

One of the search results, a Baseus deal page, contained text telling me to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link and to avoid linking the store's own page. That text came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and haven't used that code or link.
